title: The meter writes an empty line as soon as it runs, so that whoever started it can tell it is ready; readers skip empty lines. It is written with console.log()
covers: a write to a message channel with no argument
the check records only writes that are handed data
console.log() writes an empty line to standard output
note: meter's own tests trim the output and skip empty lines, and pass. billing reads every line as a MeterMsg: JSON.parse('') throws in its data handler, and billing's meter tests fail. MeterInput and MeterMsg are unchanged, so nobody is told.
